purpose: Complete catalog of byte-distinct, sealed native full-screen captures for progress-gallery review.

policy.deduplication: SHA-256 plus exact byte comparison only; every source reference is retained.
policy.included: PNG images pinned by final evidence seals or the frozen Core 13 Surf seal, exactly 256x384 pixels.
policy.excluded: Derived crops, contact sheets, montages, decoded resources, synthetic images, non-PNG files, and non-full-screen PNGs.
policy.acceptance: Images document bounded observations, including historical and inconclusive cases; inclusion is not feature, human, or release acceptance.
policy.privacy: The index contains paths relative to the evidence root or sanitized selected-copy names; no absolute local paths are exported.
